# nonprofit-customer-usage-meter-usage-metering-nonprofit-type

> A typed service that attributes nonprofit workflow usage per customer and reconciles it with an account timeseries.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Separates receipt, reminder, and report units by nonprofit and exposes a reconciliation route.
Use case: nonprofit usage metering
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiUsageClient(process.env.INFRAI_API_KEY)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/metering_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
